messages:
Maya (PR): Quick ping re: analyst + press rollout for 2027-05-12. Proposal: embargo lift 09:00 PT, but stagger regional press window so APAC gets early-morning slot. Need final quote language + fact-check flow by Tue.
Ethan (Growth): I can coordinate the staggered invites. Suggest two embargo lifts: 09:00 PT for Americas/EU, 00:00 UTC for APAC? Means we send APAC materials earlier but mark embargo specifically.
Noah (Legal): We prefer single embargo timestamp to avoid confusion. If you must stagger, add clear timezone strings and an explicit embargo clause in the kit. Also: any analyst deep dives pre-embargo require a short fact-check NDA.
Lena (Product): We'll prepare a compact tech note for analysts (1 page) + an appendix with perf caveats. Put the appendix behind NDA if needed.
Sofia (Sales): For inbound: recommend tag rules: press -> SDRs, analysts -> AE + 'analyst-lead' tag. Add a quick script for SDRs to triage press leads. I can draft the script.
Maya (PR): Draft quote (please edit): "Redwood Inference reduces per-token inference cost while keeping median latency low; see benchmark appendix for test conditions."
Noah (Legal): Edit suggestion: add "as measured in our internal benchmark harness; results may vary by workload and configuration." That wording is sign-off-friendly.
Ethan (Growth): Calendar poll live: https://doodle.com/poll/analyst-walkthroughs-2027  please vote by Mon 5pm PT.
press-bot: Created provisional invites for Wed 11:00 PT and Thu 03:00 UTC.
Maya (PR): Action list: 1) Legal to finalize wording (Noah) by Tue EOD; 2) Product to finalize tech note + appendix (Lena) by Mon noon; 3) Growth to lock briefing slots after poll (Ethan); 4) Sales to draft SDR script and routing rules (Sofia) by Wed.
Noah (Legal): :thumbsup: I will add the NDA template and conservative language.
Lena (Product): :thumbsup: appendix will include p50/p95 and a footnote with batch/seq settings.
Sofia (Sales): :thumbsup: will send draft script Wed.
Maya (PR): Thanks team. If anyone needs to change embargo time, flag here immediately so we don't send conflicting timestamps in the kit.
